meta.name: amazon-buy-box-monitor-api-skill
meta.description: This skill helps users extract basic product details other sellers prices and seller ratings from Amazon via ASIN automatically using the BrowserAct API. Agent should proactively apply this skill when users express needs like query Amazon buy box information, monitor Amazon product prices, extract Amazon product details by ASIN, check other sellers prices on Amazon, get Amazon seller ratings and feedback count, monitor buy box ownership for a specific ASIN, track Amazon fulfillment methods for competitors, compare Amazon product prices across different sellers, retrieve Amazon buy box availability status, analyze Amazon seller profile details.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动提取亚马逊商品详情、卖家价格和评分
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要监控亚马逊Buy Box信息或跟踪竞品价格
copy.tagline_en: Automatically extract Amazon product details, seller prices, and ratings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor Amazon Buy Box info or track competitor prices

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的 ASIN 和站点，自动从亚马逊提取商品标题、购物车拥有者、价格、库存、其他卖家报价及卖家评分等结构化数据。
howto.when: 当你提到“查购物车”、“监控价格”、“提取商品详情”等关键词，或要求分析亚马逊卖家信息时，Claude 会自动调用此技能。

say.text: 查一下 ASIN B005O2ZU68 的购物车是谁在占。
say.note: 返回购物车拥有者、价格等信息。

say.text: 监控这个 ASIN 的价格变化，看看其他卖家卖多少。
say.note: 返回当前价格及其他卖家列表。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can automatically extract structured data from Amazon for a given ASIN and marketplace, including product title, buy box owner, price, stock, other sellers' offers, and seller ratings.
howto.when_en: When you mention keywords like 'check buy box', 'monitor price', 'extract product details', or ask to analyze Amazon seller info, Claude will proactively apply this skill.

say_en.text: Check who owns the buy box for ASIN B005O2ZU68.
say_en.note: Returns buy box owner, price, etc.

say_en.text: Monitor price changes for this ASIN and see other sellers' prices.
say_en.note: Returns current price and other sellers list.
